actions.action: Isolate the plant away from other plants
Wash hands after handling the plant
Dab each bug with 70% isopropyl alcohol on a cotton swab, checking nodes, leaf undersides and stem joints, repeating every 2-3 days
Spray whole plant with insecticidal soap weekly for 3-4 weeks
Check other plants for white fluff or bugs along stems and soil line
If other plants are infested, treat them the same way
Keep plant isolated for another month after bugs are gone, then return it to group

reason: The answer names mealybugs as the main diagnosis and leads with dabbing them with alcohol and inspecting, matching the fix that worked; the extra soap spray, applied separately from the alcohol, is not harmful.
